verdict.rationale: GlitchTip records errors as issues. Release notes name 'issue fingerprint grouping' and 'merge issue support', which point to automatic grouping plus ways to correct it. These are only blog headlines with no documentation of how stack-trace fingerprinting works or how custom grouping rules are configured. Missing for 10: documentation of the default stack-trace fingerprinting algorithm, documented custom fingerprint/grouping rule configuration, evidence of deduplicating thousands of events into one issue, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform groups thousands of duplicate events into one issue via stack-trace fingerprinting, and I can customize the grouping when it gets it wrong

citations.quote: GlitchTip 3.3.0: Feedback survey, uptime port monitoring, issue fingerprint grouping
record the error as an issue so you can see the details
